l.i: 29. Præterea dixit Deus, Ecce dedi vobis omnes herbas profe-
rentes semen, quæ sunt in superficie totius terræ, omnesque arbores,
in quibus est fructus arboreus; proferentes semen: vestra ad come-
dendum erunt.
30. Omnibus autem bestiis terræ, & omnibus volucribus
cœli, omnibusque reptantibus super terrâ, in quibus est anima viuens,
dedi omnes herbas virides ad comedendum: & factum fuit ita.
31. Tum inspexit Deus, quidquid fecerat, ecce autem bonum
erat valde. Atque ita facta fuit vespera, & factum fuit mane, dies
sext-
us.

page.notes: The left and right edges of the scan show the neighbouring page (fragments such as "lies", "&", "re-", "ium") and were left out. The word "quæ-uis" in verse 9 is uncertain: the abbreviation and the letters after "quæ-" are hard to read. The mark after "omnemq" is a flourish that I have read as the abbreviation for -que. The verse numbers in the left margin (5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35) are marginal references and are given as notes. The catchword "volu-" and the signature "E" are at the foot.
